title: Revert line
description: One row of a revert, as jsonb text from basalt_meta.preview_revert or prepare_revert. RESTORE lines are written; SKIP lines are left as they are and named. Lines are ordered COLLATE "C". See CONTRACT.md, Revert.

op.description: The inverse write the revert runs: DELETE undoes an INSERT, INSERT re-inserts a deleted row, UPDATE restores old values.

key.description: Primary key the inverse write targets: the row's current key, or the key it is re-inserted with.

now.description: The full row as it is now; null when it does not exist.

set.description: The values the revert writes (the row before the first in-scope change, generated columns left out); null for DELETE.

conflict.description: Why the row is skipped; null for RESTORE. See CONTRACT.md, Revert, Conflicts.

sqlState.description: Set only for CONSTRAINT: the SQLSTATE the trial write raised.

cascaded.description: The first in-scope change reached this row through an FK cascade.

changeIds.description: The in-scope changes that touched this row, in ledger order.

rowHash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of jsonb_build_array(key, now, set)::text.

redacted.description: The role that prepared the revert cannot SELECT this table, so key and values are hidden.
